All bedrooms have en-suite bathrooms.

Welcome to your dream beach home, perfectly situated just one lot away from the pristine shores of the Gulf of Mexico in beautiful Santa Rosa Beach. This beach house offers breathtaking water views and embodies the ultimate coastal lifestyle. Offering 5 Bedrooms and 5 Bathrooms with a spacious and inviting floor plan, each room is designed with comfort and style in mind, providing ample space for guests. The airy, open layout seamlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas, creating a perfect space for moments spent creating lasting memories with those you love. Enjoy the Gulf breeze and stunning sunsets from your choice of 3 expansive porches. Each is ideal for relaxing while enjoying a favorite beverage and time with friends and family.
With its charming architectural details and cozy ambiance, this home exudes timeless coastal charm. Located in a gated neighborhood in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach, you're just a very short walk away from a variety of restaurants and shops, making it easy to enjoy the best of what the area has to offer!
This home has been thoughtfully appointed with amazing extras!
**Pack and Play
**High Chair
**Amazing Coffee Bar with options for everyone's favorite style of brew (espresso machine that also brews nespresso pods and kcups, cold brew maker. coffee grinder, and more!)
**Air Fryer/Toaster Oven
**Blackstone Gas Grill
So much more!
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description:
Located in Santa Rosa Beach, this vacation home is on the beach. While the natural beauty of Blue Mountain Beach and Grayton Beach State Park can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Traveling with kids? Consider Sundog Books and Sirens at the Beach. Be sure to check out the area's animals with activities such as game walks and birdwatching.
